items: 【Crystal Clear 1.85" Display & Reliable IP68 Waterproof】Experience fluid navigation with the 1.85-inch HD full-touch screen, powered by upgraded sensors for zero-lag operation. Whether you're swimming or sweating, the IP68 waterproof rating ensures durability during most water sports. Redesigned with Bluetooth 5.4, the D1 smartwatch provides a reinforced stable connection and faster data sync, ensuring your watch stays paired with your device throughout the day.

【Health Tracker】D1 fitness watch features over 100 sports modes, which can meet the need of most sports enthusiasts. It can automatically track your daily steps, distance, and calories. 24/7 heart rate and blood oxygen monitoring to help you better understand your physical condition. Use the in-depth sleep analysis to understand your REM/Light sleep cycles, helping you build healthier habits and a balanced lifestyle based on real-time data.

【Make/Answer Calls & Instant Smart Notifications】Never miss a beat while on the go. Once paired via Bluetooth, you can make and answer crystal-clear calls directly from your wrist. The optimized notification system ensures you receive vibrations for incoming texts and social media alerts (Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) without delay. It's the perfect hands-free companion for driving, working, or exercising.

【Seamless Compatibility & Personalized Watch Faces】D1 smart watch works as an extension of your phone so you can do more while on the go, bringing more convenience to your life. It works seamlessly with iPhone and Android phones. Setting up is easy with our step-by-step pairing guide. This smart watch can offer over 200 personalized watch faces to choose from, and you can also customize your watch face with your favorite photos to highlight your unique personality.

【All-Day Stress Management & Mental Wellness】 Take a deep breath and let the D1 watch guide you to a calmer state. Featuring real-time Stress Tracking and Mood Monitoring, this smartwatch helps you identify emotional patterns throughout the day. When stress levels peak, you can use the built-in Guided Breathing exercises offering instant relaxation to center your mind. It’s more than a fitness tracker; it’s a dedicated wellness companion that cares for your mental health as much as your physical performance.

【Your All-in-One Smart Assistant】Beyond fitness, the D1 is a powerful daily tool. Access a built-in voice assistant, calculator, stopwatch, female cycle tracking, and music control with a single tap. With its exceptional battery efficiency (7 days of regular use on a single charge) and diverse feature set, it’s not just a watch—it’s an essential assistant that keeps your life organized and your health on track.
